description: This Java class 'SendConf' represents a specific PDU (Protocol Data Unit) for MMS messaging, particularly the Send Confirmation message. It includes methods to set and get message ID, response status, and transaction ID, and is part of an MMS library implementation.

classes.name: SendConf
classes.description: Represents a MMS Send Confirmation PDU, allowing setting and retrieving message ID, response status, and transaction ID.

methods.name: SendConf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SendConf object, potentially throwing an InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: SendConf
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with specified headers.

methods.description: Retrieves the message ID as a byte array.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the message ID using a byte array.

methods.name: setResponseStatus
methods.description: Sets the response status code, may throw InvalidHeaderValueException.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID as a byte array.
